instruction: Build exactly one closed solid quarter-annular rectangular strip in Rhino, in millimeters. In its local frame: centerline radius 100, radial width 20 (inner radius 90 and outer radius 110), height 10 along +Z from z=0 to 10. The strip runs counterclockwise from +X to +Y through 90 degrees in the XY plane. Translate the complete shape by [150, -80, 25] in world XYZ. Use a single-rail sweep with planar end capping. Delete all construction curves; leave only the final solid. Inspect the result before claiming completion.
